cases.objective: For a tenant considering early exit, identify the contractual break dates, notice requirements, break premium and stated term expiry. Do not determine whether conditions are satisfied.

findings.title: Contractual term expiry date
findings.interpretation: The lease grants a term of 15 years commencing 1 January 2024, expiring on 31 December 2038, subject to earlier determination by break clause. This is the guaranteed contractual expiry absent early termination.
findings.relevance: Establishes the default lease end date and baseline for assessing early exit options.
findings.next_step: Confirm current date to calculate time remaining and assess whether break dates remain available.
findings.uncertainty: Expiry date is stated clearly; no ambiguity on contractual term length or commencement.

No rent account, payment schedule, or arrears statement is included in the lease document.
The lease does not reference any prior correspondence, notices of default, or demands for payment relating to rent arrears.

No external payment records, bank statements, or landlord accounts are provided to verify actual rent payment history.
The lease contains no acknowledgment by either party of any existing arrears as at the date of execution (1 January 2024).
